Pinned verifier packages fetched read-only to the session scratchpad for tool/normalisation facts: playwright-core@1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05 (dependency of @playwright/mcp@0.0.79) lib/coreBundle.js; harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 rewardkit/models.py
evidence:
STATIC READING PASSES; NO CONFIGURED JUDGE RUN HAS EXERCISED ANY GATE, hence risk=true.

1. Real gate lives in the gate dimensions. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0'. tests/gates/render/judge.toml:15 'aggregation = "all_pass"', :23 'Incorrect password must leave the visitor signed out; the correct seeded password then signs in and reveals a substantive recruiting workspace ... A static login/workspace picture or only a health response is insufficient.' (auth leg with its positive control, render/prompt.md:9). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25: UI-created requisition (budget 1000.00) plus a PENDING offer, then 'In a new independent empty browser context, sign in ... and navigate through the operational UI to retrieve the same newly created requisition and offer'; 'A static seed response, no-op success message, browser-only mutation or requisition-only app does not satisfy the gate.' (server-backing leg, real write + independent-context readback, as REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' requires). Enforcement: tests/tools/score.py:41 'gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...)', :44 scored dims forced to 0.0 unless gates passed, :48 reward 0.0; tests/test.sh:213-222 runs gates first and exits before the scored suite on status 1. test.sh and tools/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 bd682592...e5aa and 13de2b38...c04e in both trees).

2. Every scored prompt restates an in-dimension gate that hard-zeros. functional/prompt.md:11 '## Global browser gate and independent scoring', :13 minimal backend check (UI requisition create, new empty context via newContext, sign in, retrieve exact record; 'a same-context tab/reload or HTTP200 is insufficient. A static seed/no-op response or browser-only save fails'), :15 'A blank/static shell, unavailable operational app or observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion0.' All 152 functional criteria are type binary, so 'every binary criterion' is every criterion. polish/prompt.md:9 '## Global browser gate', :12 'Blank/static nonoperational shells or an observed failure of that check receive binary0 throughout.' (5/5 binary). visual/prompt.md:9 '## Global browser gate', :12 'A blank/static nonworking shell or an observed failure of that check gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score1, which normalizes to zero.' Verified against the pinned scorer: harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 rewardkit/models.py:47 'return max(0.0, min(1.0, (float(raw) - 1) / (self.points - 1)))', so raw 1 on a 5-point likert is exactly 0.0; no scored prompt awards partial credit on gate failure. Auth leg is carried in each scored gate by signing in through ordinary controls with two seeded accounts; the wrong-password negative stays in the real render gate.

3. No same-origin requirement. grep -niE 'same-origin|same origin|cross-origin' over tests/**/*.md and *.toml returns nothing as a requirement; the only 'origin' hits are the word 'original'. task.toml:22 and :38 network_mode = "public"; no prompt penalises CDN/off-origin assets. The Internal sheet's older wording ('hard-zeros blank/static-shell/cross-origin apps') conflicts with the Quality Checks sheet and the skill delivery profile ('Never report them'; quality-checks.md:125 'Defect: a gate that requires same-origin'); the current public-network instruction governs and the task follows it. Recorded as a conflict, not a finding.

4. No hidden requirement in the gates. Recruiter requisition creation is public (hireops_rules.md:38 'Provide requisition creation for the Recruiter'), all non-Auditor roles may raise offers (:44), Auditor 'reviews requisitions, offers ...' (:34), offers are created 'straight at status PENDING' (:199-201), identifiers 'may be generated or entered' (:203). The gates forbid demanding a label, route, selector, schema, ID prefix or DB-engine probe (constraints/judge.toml:25, prompt.md:13), allow fallback accounts, and allow an empty operational desk (render/judge.toml:23; instruction.md:17). Golden source has the needed surfaces (hireops.js:76 'Create requisition' UI action; index.js:111 401 on bad password; :318/:330 create routes behind auth()).

5. Tool feasibility of the gate's independent context: the prompts name browser_run_code_unsafe; the pinned @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 depends on playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05, whose lib/coreBundle.js:67028-67030 defines 'capability: "core"' / 'name: "browser_run_code_unsafe"' with a page argument, so the tool exists by default in the pinned verifier. This is a source reading of the package, not an executed judge call.

Weak apps tried on paper: blank page / static shell / accept-any-password login fail hro_gate_render; localStorage-only or no-op-success apps fail hro_gate_shared and each scored gate on the fresh-context readback; a requisition-only app fails hro_gate_shared explicitly; a health-only server fails both. A server that keeps data only in process memory passes the gates, which is intended (durability across restart is scored in P10, and the gate must not infer SQLite). An app persisting through an off-origin data service would also pass; the row forbids a same-origin test, so that brief clause is not gate-enforceable.
Conforming alternatives tried: generated vs entered IDs, no title/department field, other intake-capable account, empty seeded desk, cents vs dollars display, CDN fonts/scripts: none is failed by the gate wording.

Residual observations (not defects for this row): (a) the three scored gates each create one more requisition, tolerated by functional/prompt.md:17 and constraints/judge.toml:26, but it is added judge workload not yet timed; (b) a tool/evaluator failure inside a gate returns binary 0 / Likert 1 labelled 'NOT EXERCISED', which under the frozen all_pass policy zeroes the reward for a working app; this is template scoring policy, honestly labelled, and cannot be changed in the task.

Missing measurements: raw-evidence-index.json scope states full configured grading is absent. I re-hashed 8 indexed artifacts plus two solution files and all matched the index. The scripted run (live-desk.cjs:25, :59) creates requisitions and signs in through the API, so it does not exercise the gate path (UI requisition creation, wrong-password refusal, fresh-context UI readback by the GLM judge). Whether the configured judge actually passes both gates on the golden, and fails them on a shell, is unmeasured.
